why: In the first pair the black square jumps to the opposite corner: bottom-left goes to top-right. So in the second pair the black square at top-left jumps to the opposite corner, bottom-right. Option 3 fits. Option 2 keeps the old square and adds a new one, which is wrong.
trick: Opposite corner jumps are the same as turning the figure halfway round (180 degrees).
